title: The Signature Vision: Wave-Powered Towns
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Wave-Powered Towns.

Signature wave hulls program, charter one: master converter farms at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale town logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate mooring grids systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Wave-Powered Towns becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — The first permanent wave hulls hosts 500 residents year-round
definition: 2030 milestone on the Wave-Powered Towns roadmap.

title: Readiness Estimator: Wave-Powered Towns
definition: Estimates Wave-Powered Towns readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Wave-Powered Towns components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a wave hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Wave-Powered Towns Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Wave-Powered Towns operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Wave-Powered Towns installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 13053 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where converter farms monitoring, town logistics redundancy, or mooring grids maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Wave-Powered Towns Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Wave-Powered Towns: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Wave-Powered Towns — towns running on the motion of the sea itself.

Phase 1 — Prove (converter farms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (town logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mooring grids): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (power smoothing): wave hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and coastal waters-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
